note: tools/judges/cutscene_skip_judge.py: every scripted cutscene of the disc (tools/cutscenes/census.py's 51 sites), each by its site and the graphs only it runs (the table the game's cross button consults is made of them: tools/cutscenes/skip_table.py), its status and, for those a test reaches, how: the hub card warped to its chunk (tools/warp_save.py, LOAD GAME with the Academy entry pad log's presses), the cutscene starting at the level's entry or by TE_CUTSCENE_START (its director given its trigger's behaviour), or a pad log / plan that walks to it. Leg W watches it, leg S presses CROSS two boundaries into it (tools/cutscenes/verify.py). status pass: the skip leaves the watched state (compare.py's verdict over `span` boundaries of play, under `rule` -- places within its floor, what two watchings in play mode differ by, or a class's bound -- and the cutscene's `allow`: what of an agent runs on the world's time, with the reason; everything else exact), plays on, and is shorter than watching; status refused: the cross button does nothing there (`why` says why in plain words) and the skipped leg plays exactly as the watched one. `mechanism` is the skip's own result where refused (the judge's --mechanism legs measure it with TE_CUTSCENE_SKIP_ALL=1); a refused cutscene without a chunk is not reached by any test yet.

rule.floor_why: two watchings of one cutscene in play mode on the Vita (its frames of two and three fields) end the player 0 to 0.0334 apart where the cutscene puts him down: the cavern's and the Dingodile fight's 0, the totem's 0.0002, the treasure room's 0.0018, Dingodile's hut's 0.0270, the emu farmer's 0.0334; further where he ends falling, on a slope or on a board (the falling totem 0.17, Rockslide 0.20, the shed 1.18: a cutscene that needs it carries its own allowance); on the desktop 0, no frame there losing a field

classes.why: a wumpa fruit bobs 0.25 up and down on the world's time (175 bobbing fruits measured over the watched legs) and an unseen one keeps the phase of its last update
